title: Rabbi Leibel Druck Passes
body: Rabbi Leibel Druck z”l, a respected Karlin-Stolin community member, passed away at 79 after a period of illness. He was a longtime melamed at Etz Chaim and had recently resided in Beitar Illit.

title: The Shtreimel's Lost Dignity
body: A shtreimel, once a symbol of dignity and inherited mesorah, has become a spectacle demanding attention and applause, its wearer turned into a walking show, as subtlety is declared obsolete and excess is crowned.
